csv_agency: Town of Dennis - Dept of Public Works
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Dennis is seeking qualifications from qualified Massachusetts registered engineering firms/individuals to provide professional engineering, surveying and planning services associated with potential Town projects on an on-call (as-needed) basis. Services will be related to horizontal construction projects only. The goal is to select a short-list of consulting firms that specialize in various types of design for a period of 3 years. As projects arise, the Town will choose the best suited Consultant from the short-list to provide the desired service, thereby eliminating the need to advertise for each project. The Town will negotiate a fee for said services based on the Hourly Rate Schedule provided in the Consultant s response and initiate the work through a written Notice to Proceed under the Contract Agreement.
